missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Скала' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Высокая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'у моря' is the genitive location.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Скалу' is the feminine accusative object of 'покорили'. 'Крутую' agrees in the feminine accusative, describing the steepness they conquered.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Скалы' is the genitive after 'с вершины' to show origin. 'Вид' is the nominative subject, and 'открывается' marks the unfolding view.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К скале' takes the dative after 'к' to express movement toward. 'Лодка' is the nominative subject, and 'плыла' agrees with it in the feminine.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Над скалой' uses the instrumental after 'над' to show location above. 'Орёл' is the nominative subject, and 'сидел' describes its position.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'На скале' uses the prepositional 'скале' after 'на' to mark location. 'Сосна' is the nominative subject, and 'одинокая' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'О скалу' uses the accusative after 'о' to show impact against a surface. 'Волны' is the nominative plural subject crashing into it.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a number. After 'две' the noun takes the genitive singular 'скалы'. 'Высокие' agrees in the plural, and 'стояли' agrees with the plural notion.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Скалы' is the nominative plural subject of 'возвышаются'. 'Серые' agrees in the plural, and 'над морем' is the instrumental location.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Скалы' is the inanimate feminine plural accusative, matching the nominative plural. 'Красивые' agrees in the plural, and 'фотографировали' takes them as objects.
